title: Native inverse pushforward on the specified ordinary small model
statement: Let Y be any scheme in universe u, l a prime, and g:Y≅Y any scheme automorphism. Fix any normalized native Hom comparison H [lem-sf-adic-module-hom-comparison-core]. Use exactly the site, ring, ringIso, additive equivalence E, and natural Hom comparison h constructed in [def-sf-native-frobenius-model-data]. Write S for their specified translation/scalar-transport module functor. There is a natural isomorphism c:E.functor ⋙ adicLowerStar(l,g.inv) ≅ S ⋙ E.functor. For every twisted presentation P [lem-sf-twisted-action-ringed-site] and small-site modules M,N, the composite of native inverse pushforward of h(M,N), native inverse-pushforward Hom comparison, precomposition by c_M inverse, and postcomposition by c_N equals c_Hom followed by E(P.sigmaHom) and h(SM,SN). No choice of a site, ring, ordinary equivalence or ordinary Hom isomorphism is included in this assertion.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison and naturality of evaluation paragraph; ordinary small-site restriction and Frobenius translation.

proof.text: Use nativeFrobeniusSectionTransport to construct c and obtain its section normalization. This identifies native inverse pushforward with the specified translation, with no arbitrary isomorphism chosen.

Use the sectionwise internal-Hom evaluation criterion. Pull a test module section back along c_M inverse. Native precomposition and postcomposition evaluation, inverse-isomorphism cancellation, and pushforward evaluation reduce the native side. Apply the injective section counit. The normalization of c_N and naturality of restriction move to the translated object. Evaluate both fixed Hom comparisons by their identity-slice formula. Counit naturality for P.sigmaHom and the normalization of c_Hom and c_M leave the identity-slice translation formula for P.sigmaHom, which holds for every presentation by its pure-tensor evaluation axioms.

proof_origin.place: Native ringed-model proof steps 1--3, realized by concrete section transport and identity-slice evaluation; every companion lemma is proved.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeFrobeniusComparison (Y : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (g : Y ≅ Y) (H : AdicModuleHomComparisonCore l Y) :
    let _ := (translation_continuous Y g).1
    let _ := (translation_continuous Y g).2
    let E := equivalence Y l
    let S := sigma (topology Y) (translation g) (ring Y l) (ringIso Y l g)
    ∃ c : E.functor ⋙ adicLowerStar l g.inv ≅ S ⋙ E.functor,
      ∀ (P : Presentation (topology Y) (translation g) (ring Y l) (ringIso Y l g))
        (M N : Modules (ring Y l)),
      (adicLowerStar l g.inv).map (homComparison Y l H M N).hom ≫
          (adicLowerStarCompIhomIso l g.inv (E.functor.obj M)).inv.app (E.functor.obj N) ≫
          (Mod.ihomMap (c.app M).inv).app _ ≫
            (AdicSheaf.ihom (E.functor.obj (S.obj M))).map (c.app N).hom =
        c.hom.app (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := ring Y l) M N) ≫
          E.functor.map (P.sigmaHom M N).hom ≫
            (homComparison Y l H (S.obj M) (S.obj N)).hom
